_doc: Necropathy locked pixel-art palette (GDD 15.0 'Art pass (true pixel art)'; docs/art/ART_BIBLE.md 'Palette').
Single source of truth for tools/prepare_sprite.py (grid mode snaps every pixel to these colours),
tools/art_check.py (flags off-palette pixels) and the art bible's colour table.
colors: name, hex (sRGB), ramp (primary ramp), index (position in that ramp, 0 = darkest),
group (ink = outline darks, unit = body colours, glow = emissive highlights, floor = ground only),
role (what it is for). Floor colours are never used by sprites (prepare_sprite.py never snaps to them).
ramps: ordered dark -> light lists of colour names. members[0] is the ramp's outline ink (the darkest
shade of that hue). A ramp may borrow a colour whose primary ramp is another one (the ice ramp's shade
is the cold grey, the gold ramp's shade is the light brown), which keeps the palette small.
Outline of a pixel = members[0] of its colour's primary ramp; rim light = the next member after it.
Lightness targets (OKLab L, 0-1): inks 0.17-0.21 (just below the floors), floors 0.21-0.30,
